defs.def: the feeling that you can trust, believe in and be sure about the abilities or good qualities of sb/sth 信心；信任；信赖

ex.s: “ _____50_____ , I had little confidence in the beginning,” says Ursula, “but the Sunflower Farm rose to fame and has become one of the most sought-after _____51_____ in the province.”
ex.t: "____说实话，起初我没什么信心，"乌苏拉说，"但向日葵农场声名鹊起，成为全省最热门的____景点之一。"

ex.s: And when people started ___9___, that gave me a boost of confidence.
ex.t: 当人们开始___9___时，这给了我信心上的鼓舞。

ex.s: Hence, they have the advantage of clarity and confidence.
ex.t: 因此，他们拥有清晰和自信的优势。

ex.s: Since June 2017, right before the ___56___ (arrive) of the two new pandas, Meng Meng and Jiao Qing, I have been helping the panda keepers at the zoo to feel more comfortable and ___57___ (confidence) speaking English.
ex.t: 自2017年6月起，就在两只新熊猫梦梦和娇庆___56___（arrive）到来之前，我一直在帮助动物园的熊猫饲养员更轻松、更___57___（confidence）自信地说英语。

ex.t: 这些新的每一步都在增强我的自信。

ex.s: His confidence in PyQuantum.
ex.t: 他对PyQuantum的信心。

ex.s: Many people now misunderstand emotional intelligence as almost everything desirable in a person's makeup that cannot be measured by an IQ test, such as character, motivation, confidence, mental stability, optimism and "people skills." Research has shown that emotional skills may contribute to some of these qualities, but most of them move far beyond skill-based emotional intelligence.
ex.t: 现在许多人把情商误解为一个人特质中几乎所有无法用智商测试衡量的可取之处，比如性格、动力、自信、心理稳定、乐观和“人际技巧”。研究表明，情绪技能可能有助于其中一些品质，但大多数远远超出了基于技能的情商。

ex.s: It was only a five-week course but it awakened my interest and got my confidence up.
ex.t: 那只是门五周的课程，却唤醒了我的兴趣，让我重拾信心。

ex.s: I recorded myself with confidence.
ex.t: 老师让我们录下自己谈论假期的内容。

ex.s: What gave Vinnie confidence to make her request of President Lincoln? （    ）
ex.t: 第二天，薇妮就收到了总统的邀请。

ex.s: Buy with confidence: 21-day money back guarantee!
ex.t: 联系与支持：customerservice@lancom.com

ex.s: Jenn Berman, author of The A to Z Guide to Raising Happy and Confident Kids, says, "We've gone to the opposite extreme of a few decades ago when parents tended to be more strict." By giving kids a lot of praise, parents think they're building their children's confidence, when, in fact, it may be just the opposite.
ex.t: 《培养快乐自信孩子的A到Z指南》作者詹·贝尔曼说：“我们走向了几十年前的反面，那时父母往往更严格。”通过给孩子大量表扬，父母以为在建立孩子的自信，而事实上可能恰恰相反。

ex.s: It raises people’s confidence.
ex.t: 它提高人们的信心。

ex.s: “But we all have to accept that as we get older our reactions slow down and this often results in people avoiding any potentially challenging driving conditions and losing confidence in their driving skills.
ex.t: “但我们都必须接受，随着年龄增长，我们的反应会变慢，这通常导致人们避开任何可能有挑战的驾驶状况，并对自己的驾驶技术失去信心。”

ex.s: Hit the streets with confidence. _____33_____ Say, “Excuse me, I work for XYZ News, and I was wondering if you could share your opinion about this topic.” This is a quick way to get people to warm up to you.
ex.t: 自信地上街。_____33_____说：“打扰一下，我为XYZ新闻工作，我想知道您能否分享一下对这个问题的看法。”这是让人对你放下戒备的快速方法。

defs.def: a belief in your own ability to do things and be successful 自信心

ex.s: Having seen quite a few productions of Hamlet and read the play many times, I was full of confidence - until the Peking Opera came to town!
ex.t: 看过不少版本的《哈姆雷特》演出，也读过很多遍剧本，我信心满满——直到京剧版本登场！

ex.s: Now we have another chance to look up at the starts of New Orleans, their beauty inspiring us and giving us confidence to move on.
ex.t: 现在我们又有机会仰望新奥尔良的星空，它们的美丽激励着我们，给予我们继续前行的信心。

ex.s: Each “like” boosts my confidence.
ex.t: 每一个"点赞"都增强了我的信心。

ex.s: Dr Hart says: Obsessive online photo editing indicates lack of self-confidence and a desire for attention.
ex.t: 哈特博士说：强迫性的在线照片编辑表明缺乏自信和关注欲望。

ex.s: It plays a part in the image we present to the world, and making an effort with your appearance can leave a positive first impression on others and boost your confidence.
ex.t: 它在我们展现给世界的形象中起着重要作用，用心打理外表可以给他人留下积极的第一印象，并增强你的自信。

defs.def: the feeling that you are certain about sth 把握；肯定
a feeling of trust that sb will keep information private （对某人会保守秘密的）信任，信赖
a secret that you tell sb （向某人透露的）秘密，机密
